facts.fact: The Banco de Cabo Verde says payment institutions and e-money institutions must be authorised by it to provide payment services or issue e-money, under Decree-Laws 8/2018 and 9/2018 and Aviso 6/2019.
facts.system: Instituições de Pagamento e de Moeda Eletrónica

facts.fact: The Banco de Cabo Verde says it manages SICIL, the interbank clearing system for cheques, credit transfers and payment cards operated by SISP, and oversees the payment system under its oversight policy.

systems.system: SICIL (Sistema Integrado de Compensação Interbancária e Liquidação)
systems.owner: Banco de Cabo Verde, operated by SISP
